notes.title: We made it! Broken Relic has reached it's funding goal!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334040/da49422ab764877a528c400097047d93652432a9.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone! I can’t believe I’m writing this already, [b]Broken Relic has officially reached 100% of its funding goal![/b][/p][p align="start"]With still 18 days to go, with your incredible support, this little passion project has gone from a dream on my desk to a fully funded adventure game. Thank you so, so much to every single backer who pledged, shared the campaign, played the demo, and spread the word. I’m truly humbled by the response and excited to bring Broken Relic to life with all the care it deserves.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What happens now?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Stretch goals ahead[/b]: Funding doesn’t stop here. Every pound over the base goal helps improve the game, from professional voice acting to music and localisation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Community power[/b]: Sharing the campaign with fellow adventure game fans is still the best way to keep momentum going.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Join the Discord!:[/b] If you haven't already, you can[u][url="https://discord.gg/6tT4h764h6"] join the Discord here[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This is only the beginning of the journey, and I’m thrilled to have you all on board. Let’s keep the adventure rolling and see how far we can take it together.[/p][p align="start"]From the bottom of my heart: thank you![/p][p align="start"]
-Pablo (Sandpenguin)[/p]
